method: HTTPS to isolated web experiment using the actual web Worker adapter and named jobs service binding. Real Better Auth and persisted session/deletion checks. Elapsed is client wall time, never CPU. First candidate is not guaranteed isolate-cold. Ten warmups and 100 samples per workload.

checks.name: default jobs HTTP entry cannot invoke owner APIs
real signed session and private owner response
missing, tampered, expired, revoked and deleting sessions fail
exact Origin, JSON type and method checks
malformed, unsafe, unknown and oversized drafts do not write
atomic content and private progress, stale revision and owner isolation
parallel identities and conflicting saves remain request scoped
exact 1 MiB draft saves with envelope overhead
permanent fixture milestone cannot be reset
